prompt: Hi. I want to became a SME in Servicenow CSM. Could you guide me?
response: To become a SME in ServiceNow CSM, start by obtaining the ServiceNow Certified Application Professional (CASP) certification, which covers CSM. Gain hands-on experience by working on CSM projects and configurations. Participate in forums and communities to stay updated with the latest trends and best practices. Consider contributing to open-source projects or writing blogs to enhance your visibility and expertise.
